basic_details.job_title: Calicut University Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Distance and Online Education (CDOE), University of Calicut, will hold a walk-in interview on 11 December 2026 to prepare a panel of Assistant Professors in English, History and Sociology on contract basis. Reporting is at 09.30 AM for English and History and at 01.30 PM for Sociology, at the Administrative Block, University of Calicut (the notice prints no PIN). The consolidated pay is Rs. 37,000 per month.

qualification.details: The engagement is on contract basis for a panel of Assistant Professors. The term of contract is one year from the date of joining. Each subject is reserved for one category, as shown below. | The qualification for the posts is as per the UGC norms for Assistant Professors: PG with 55% aggregate in the relevant subject + NET/Ph.D. | Below 50 years as on 01.01.2026. | Candidates should check the official notification for the subject-specific eligibility of each post.

important_instructions: The nature of appointment is contract basis, for one year from the date of joining. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Reservation benefits apply only to those communities mentioned in the KS & SSR. Appointments will be made as per the rules governing communal rotation. There will not be future claims for appointment by this appointment. The University reserves the right to cancel the proceedings, in full or in part, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Calicut University Recruitment 2026 Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the last date or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About Calicut University CDOE
content_sections.text: The University of Calicut is the issuing body of this notice, which is dated 22.11.2026 and signed by Prof. (Dr.) Sebastian C. D., Registrar. The posts are in its Centre for Distance and Online Education, and the interview will be held at the University's Administrative Block.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The engagement is on contract basis for a panel of Assistant Professors. The term of contract is one year from the date of joining. Each subject is reserved for one category, as shown below. The qualification for the posts is as per the UGC norms for Assistant Professors: PG with 55% aggregate in the relevant subject + NET/Ph.D. Below 50 years as on 01.01.2026. Candidates should check the official notification for the subject-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Original certificates to prove age, qualification, experience and community. A Non-creamy-layer certificate, for candidates belonging to OBC. An equivalency certificate obtained from this University, for candidates who passed the qualifying examination from Universities outside Kerala.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The nature of appointment is contract basis, for one year from the date of joining. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Reservation benefits apply only to those communities mentioned in the KS & SSR. Appointments will be made as per the rules governing communal rotation. There will not be future claims for appointment by this appointment. The University reserves the right to cancel the proceedings, in full or in part, without assigning any reason.

rows.details: Calicut University CDOE Assistant Professor walk-in notice

faq.question: Q1. When is the Calicut University CDOE walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 11.12.2026 (11 December 2026) at the Administrative Block, University of Calicut.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time?
faq.answer: Reporting is at 09.30 AM for English and History, and at 01.30 PM for Sociology. Interviews begin at 10.30 AM and 02.30 PM respectively.

faq.question: Q3. Where will the interviews be held?
faq.answer: English and Sociology interviews are in the Syndicate Conference Hall, and History is in Mini Conference Hall-2, all at the Administrative Block, University of Calicut.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: English has 1 vacancy (LC/AI Category) and History has 1 vacancy (SC Category). Sociology (General Category) is shown as anticipated vacancies, with no number printed.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The qualification is as per UGC norms for Assistant Professors: PG with 55% aggregate in the relevant subject + NET/Ph.D.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 50 years as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the pay for the contract Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 37,000/- (Rupees thirty seven thousand only) per month, consolidated.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent post?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is on contract basis for one year from the date of joining, and the notice says there will be no future claims for appointment by this appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents should I carry?
faq.answer: Carry original certificates to prove age, qualification, experience and community, with a Non-creamy-layer certificate for OBC candidates. Candidates with qualifications from outside Kerala also need an equivalency certificate from this University.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
